scope: Brand-independent guidance for assessing newly applied exterior mineral plaster/render/stucco before a subsequent paint or coating system. Manufacturer-specific waiting times, moisture/pH limits, primers and coating build-ups remain Layer B. KONTA MOY workflow enforcement remains Layer C.

rules.claim: New exterior stucco/render repair should not be painted before the new material has cured sufficiently for the subsequent finish; the required duration is material/system dependent and must not be replaced by a universal waiting time.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Ο νέος εξωτερικός σοβάς/επίχρισμα δεν βάφεται απλώς επειδή φαίνεται στεγνός στην επιφάνεια. Πρέπει πρώτα να έχει ολοκληρώσει την απαιτούμενη ωρίμανση για το σύστημα που θα εφαρμοστεί.
rules.stop_escalation: If the render/plaster type or its curing requirement is unknown, do not invent a waiting period and do not advance to product-specific coating instructions until Layer B or the render-system documentation resolves it.

source.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Technical Preservation Services
source.title: Preservation Brief 22: The Preservation and Repair of Historic Stucco
source.relevant_section: Repair/painting guidance; new stucco curing before painting

rules.applicability_note: The general cure-before-finish principle is retained. Historic-material prescriptions and coating-specific waiting periods are not generalized to modern Greek construction.

rules.claim: Fresh stucco/render should be protected from excessively rapid drying during curing because rapid moisture loss can contribute to cracking and poor performance.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Κατά την ωρίμανση, ο φρέσκος εξωτερικός σοβάς δεν πρέπει να αφήνεται να στεγνώνει υπερβολικά γρήγορα. Η προστασία της φρέσκιας στρώσης είναι μέρος της σωστής προετοιμασίας πριν από οποιαδήποτε τελική βαφή.
rules.stop_escalation: Do not prescribe a universal misting duration, humidity target or curing method; use the render/system instructions and project conditions.

source.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Technical Preservation Services
source.title: Preservation Brief 22: The Preservation and Repair of Historic Stucco
source.relevant_section: General Guidance for Historic Stucco Repair

rules.applicability_note: Only the rapid-drying risk principle is generalized. The NPS document's historic-stucco curing figures are not made universal.

rules.claim: Weather conditions during placement and curing can materially affect exterior stucco/render; work should not be treated as independent of temperature, frost risk, sun/heat and moisture exposure.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Ο καιρός επηρεάζει όχι μόνο τη βαφή αλλά και την ίδια την ωρίμανση του νέου εξωτερικού επιχρίσματος. Πριν συνεχίσουμε σε τελικό σύστημα, ελέγχουμε ότι η βάση έχει ωριμάσει σωστά στις πραγματικές συνθήκες του έργου.
rules.stop_escalation: Do not convert the source's historic-stucco temperature values into universal Greek thresholds. Exact application/cure limits require the applicable render and coating system documentation.

source.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Technical Preservation Services
source.title: Preservation Brief 22: The Preservation and Repair of Historic Stucco
source.relevant_section: General Guidance for Historic Stucco Repair

rules.applicability_note: General weather/curing dependency only; numeric limits remain system-specific or jurisdiction/project-specific.

rules.claim: Detached, delaminated or otherwise unsound stucco/render is a substrate defect that should be repaired or otherwise technically resolved before it is concealed by a finish coating.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Αν ο νέος ή επισκευασμένος σοβάς είναι κούφιος, αποκολλημένος ή σαθρός, δεν προχωράμε σε βαφή για να κρύψουμε το πρόβλημα. Πρώτα αποκαθίσταται η σταθερότητα της βάσης.
rules.stop_escalation: Widespread detachment, uncertain bond, recurrent cracking or unexplained movement requires assessment rather than a coating-only recommendation.

source.authority: U.S. National Park Service — Technical Preservation Services
source.title: Preservation Brief 22: The Preservation and Repair of Historic Stucco

rules.applicability_note: The substrate-stability principle is general. Historic conservation repair methods are not prescribed for ordinary modern render.

unresolved.question: What universal waiting time should be used before painting new exterior plaster/render?
unresolved.reason: Cure/dry requirements depend on render composition, thickness, weather and selected coating system; product/system documentation must control.

unresolved.question: What universal substrate moisture percentage is acceptable before coating?
unresolved.reason: No single defensible threshold applies across all mineral renders and coating systems; resolve from Layer B or applicable project specification.

unresolved.question: What universal pH/alkalinity threshold should KONTA MOY use before coating new render?
unresolved.reason: Compatibility with alkaline mineral substrates is coating-system specific; do not invent a platform-wide pH cutoff.

unresolved.question: Which primer is universally required on new exterior render?
unresolved.reason: Primer need/type is manufacturer/system-specific and must come from the selected product documentation.
